bibl.title: Frammento di prosa sconosciuta (filosofica?)
bibl.seg: Nicola Reggiani, Frammento di prosa sconosciuta (filosofica?).
bibl.note: Edition of P.Cair. SR 3049/33 (Arsinoites?, II/IIIrd c.), a fragment kept at the Cairo Egyptian Museum and preserving a small amount of a literary roll, likely a philosophical prose quoting such classical authors as Euripides and Simonides.
